```{r library-and-datasheets}
#| echo: False #Added to prevent the printing of excess code
#| warning: False #Added to prevent the printing of excess code
#| message: false

required_packages <-function(...) { 
  libs<-unlist(list(...)) 
  req<-suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(unlist(lapply(libs,require,character.only=TRUE)))) 
  need<-libs[req==FALSE] 
  if(length(need)>0){ 
    install.packages(need, repos = "http://cran.us.r-project.org") 
    lapply(need, library, character.only=TRUE) 
  }
  else{message("No packages required installation.")} 
}

required_packages("tidyverse", "readxl", "writexl", "lme4", "lmerTest", "ggeffects", "emmeans", "generics")

Hydric_Phys <- read_xlsx("Hydric_Physiology.xlsx")
CEWL_Data <- read_xlsx("CEWL_Values.xlsx")
```

```{r checking-cewl}
#Check to see if they are all within their own mean or beyond
CEWL_Data |> 
  group_by(Indiv_Lizard) |> 
  mutate(IDMean = mean(`TEWL [g/(m2h)]`),
         IDSD   = sd(`TEWL [g/(m2h)]`),
         In2SD = (`TEWL [g/(m2h)]` >= IDMean - 2 * IDSD) &
           (`TEWL [g/(m2h)]` <= IDMean + 2 * IDSD)) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  summarize(Within2SD = sum(In2SD, na.rm = TRUE),
            Outside2SD = sum(!In2SD, na.rm = TRUE)) 
#average CEWL values & find cv
CEWL_Average <- CEWL_Data |> 
  group_by(Indiv_Lizard) |> 
  mutate(CEWL = mean(`TEWL [g/(m2h)]`),
         CEWL_cv = sd(`TEWL [g/(m2h)]`, na.rm = TRUE) 
         /mean(`TEWL [g/(m2h)]`, na.rm = TRUE) * 100) |>
  summarize(
    across(
      c(`AmbT [C]`,	`AmbRH [%]`, CEWL, CEWL_cv),
      mean, .names = "{.col}_mean"), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r join the data}
Lizard_Data_All <- Hydric_Phys |> 
  full_join(CEWL_Average,
            by = "Indiv_Lizard") |> 
  mutate(SexGravid = paste(Sex, `Gravid?`, sep = "_"),
         Es = 0.611 * exp((17.502*`AmbT [C]_mean`)/(`AmbT [C]_mean`+240.97)),
         Lab_VPD = Es - (Es*(`AmbRH [%]_mean`/100))) |> 
  select(!Es) |> 
  filter(!Sex == "J") |> 
  mutate(Campus = dplyr::recode(Campus,
                                "SCR" = "Scripps",
                                "CSM" = "CSUSM"),
         LizardID = str_replace(LizardID, "_0", "_")) |> 
  dplyr::rename(Posm_mean = Avg_Posm)

Lizard_Data_All$SiteSeason <- interaction(Lizard_Data_All$Site, Lizard_Data_All$Season)

```


```{r filter data cewl}
CEWL_outliers <- Lizard_Data_All |>
  group_by(Site, Season) |>
  mutate(Q1 = quantile(CEWL_mean, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 
         Q3 = quantile(CEWL_mean, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
         IQR = Q3 - Q1,
         outlier = CEWL_mean < (Q1 - 1.5 * IQR) |
                   CEWL_mean > (Q3 + 1.5 * IQR)) |> 
  ungroup()

CEWL_outliers |> 
  filter(outlier) |>
  select(LizardID, Site, Season, CEWL_mean)

ggplot(CEWL_outliers, aes(x = Season, y = CEWL_mean, color = Site)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_point(data = subset(CEWL_outliers, outlier == TRUE), color = "red")

```

```{r read in SVL}
SVL <- read_xlsx("Cool Lizards SVL.xlsx") |> 
  select(!"...9") |> 
  mutate(
    `Liz ID` = str_replace_all(`Liz ID`, "on", "ON"),
    `Liz ID` = str_replace_all(`Liz ID`, "off", "OFF"),
    `Liz ID` = str_replace_all(`Liz ID`, " ", "")
  ) |> 
  filter(!`Liz ID` %in% c(
    "CSUSB_ON_01_0003",   # replicate of Off_01, mislabeled
    "CP_OFF_12_0001",     # crooked, use the other scan
    "CSUSB_ON_06_0001",   # a replicate with a hand in the way
    "UCLA_OFF_01_0002",   # dorsal replicate
    "PEP_ON_51_0001",     # replicate
    "CP_OFF_03_0001",     # crooked
    "CP_OFF_12_0002",     # unneeded dorsal measurment
    "CSUSB_OFF_04_0001"
  )) |> 
  mutate(
    `Liz ID` = str_remove(`Liz ID`, "_000[1234]$"),
    `Liz ID` = str_replace(`Liz ID`, "_0([0-9]+)$", "_\\1"),
    Site = str_extract(`Liz ID`, "ON|OFF"),
    `Liz ID` = str_replace(`Liz ID`,"PEP(?!P)","PEPP"),
    `Liz ID` = str_replace(`Liz ID`,"SC(?!R)","SCR")) |> 
    #Campus = str_extract(`Liz ID`, "SDSU|CP|CLU|CSM|CSUSM|CSULB|CSUSB|HMC|PEPP|SCR|SC|UCLA|PEP|WC") originally used for combining datasheet & locating errors. Ignore this line
  rename(LizardID = `Liz ID`) |> 
  mutate(SiteSeason = interaction(Site, Season)) |> 
  select(!c("SVL 1","SVL 2", "SVL3", "STDEV", "CV")) |> 
  dplyr::rename(SVL = `Average`)

Combined_Lizard <- left_join(Lizard_Data_All, SVL,
                             by = c("LizardID","Site","Season", "SiteSeason"))
  
Condition_Model <- lm(log(Mass) ~ log(SVL), data = Combined_Lizard, na.action = na.exclude)

Lizard_Master <- Combined_Lizard |> 
  mutate(Sion = Mass / SVL,
         Pieg = log(Mass) - predict(Condition_Model, newdata = Combined_Lizard),
         Condition = residuals(Condition_Model)) #this is the exact same as "Pieg", different format

#Identify missing SVLs
# Missing_SVL <- 
#   anti_join(Lizard_Data_All, SVL,
#                      by = c("LizardID","Site","Season")) |> 
#   select(LizardID, Site, Season) 
  #write_xlsx("Missing SVL.xlsx")
```

```{r}
#| warning: FALSE

Lizard_Master_con_outlier <- Lizard_Master |> 
  mutate(condition_outlier = "no")

augments_df <- augment(Condition_Model, data = Combined_Lizard)

Lizard_Master_con_outlier <- augments_df |> 
  select(Indiv_Lizard, .std.resid) |> 
  right_join(Lizard_Master_con_outlier, 
             by = "Indiv_Lizard") |> 
  mutate(condition_outlier = ifelse(abs(.std.resid) > 2, "YES", "NO"))

ggplot(data = Lizard_Master_con_outlier, 
             aes(x = SVL, y = Mass)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = condition_outlier), show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_label_repel(
    data = subset(Lizard_Master_con_outlier,
                  condition_outlier == "YES", force = 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    aes(label = Indiv_Lizard))+
  theme_bw()+
  labs(title = "Body Condition Outliers")

# head(sort(abs(augments_df$.std.resid), decreasing = TRUE))
```

```{r}
options(na.action = "na.fail")

CEWL_data_clean <- Lizard_Master |>
  select(CEWL_mean, Season, Site, Condition, Lab_VPD, SexGravid, Campus) |>
  drop_na()

Posm_data_clean <- Lizard_Master |>
  select(Posm_mean, Season, Site, Condition, SexGravid, Campus) |>
  drop_na()

Hem_data_clean <- Lizard_Master |>
  select(Hematocrit, Season, Site, Condition, SexGravid, Campus) |>
  drop_na()

lmer_CEWL_dredge <- lmer(CEWL_mean ~ 
                      Season + Site + Condition + 
                      Season:Site + Site:Condition + Season:Condition +
                      Lab_VPD + SexGravid +
                      (1|Campus) + (1|Season:Campus),
                      data = CEWL_data_clean, REML = F)
lmer_Posm_dredge <- lmer(Posm_mean ~ 
                       Season + Site + Condition + 
                       Season:Site + Site:Condition + Season:Condition +
                       SexGravid +
                       (1|Season:Campus) + (1|Site:Campus),
                       data = Posm_data_clean, REML = F)
lmer_Hemato_dredge <- lmer(Hematocrit ~ 
                         Season + Site + Condition + 
                         Season:Site + Site:Condition + Season:Condition +
                         SexGravid +
                         (1|Campus) + (1|Season:Campus) + (1|Site:Campus),
                         data = Hem_data_clean, REML = F)


dredge_fit_CEWL <- dredge(lmer_CEWL)
dredge_fit_Posm <- dredge(lmer_Posm_dredge)
dredge_fit_Hem <- dredge(lmer_Hemato_dredge)

subset(dredge_fit_CEWL, delta < 2)
subset(dredge_fit_Posm, delta < 2)
subset(dredge_fit_Hem, delta < 2)

```

```{r}
# PLASMA OSMOLALITY MODEL
lmer_Posm <- lmer(log(Posm_mean) ~ 
                  Season + scale(Condition) + Site + SexGravid
                  + (1|Campus)
                  ,
                  data = filter(low_cond, !is.na(Posm_mean)), REML = F)
# I removed all interactions as they were only marginally significant once ecto was removed
# we have no good reason to include ecto and it's hard to interpret all these interactions
# the simpler model is better and easier to understand
anova(lmer_Posm)
summary(lmer_Posm)

# Model evaluation with DHARMa
# Running basic simulation for residuals
library(DHARMa)
simulationOutput <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = lmer_Posm, n = 500)
#simulationOutput$scaledResiduals

#Plotting results
plot(simulationOutput) #slight deviations present at lower end, #qqplot good

data_Posm_lmer <- low_cond %>% filter(!is.na(Posm_mean),
                                      !is.na(Condition))

#####Checking resids against factors
plotResiduals(simulationOutput, form = data_Posm_lmer$Season) #looks good
plotResiduals(simulationOutput, form = data_Posm_lmer$Site) #looks good
plotResiduals(simulationOutput, form = data_Posm_lmer$Condition) #deviations present, but not terrible

#####Testing for overdispersion.
testDispersion(simulationOutput) #looks good

```

```{r}
# HEMATOCRIT MODEL!
# remove two individual with high conditions (let's look into these)
low_cond <- subset(Lizard_Master, Condition < 0.4)
lmer_Hem <- lmer(Hematocrit ~ Season*Site + scale(Condition) 
                 + SexGravid + (1|Campus),
                 data = filter(low_cond, !is.na(Hematocrit)), REML = F)
anova(lmer_Hem) 
summary(lmer_Hem)
# the significant three-way interaction is entirely driven by two
              # individuals with unusually high condition values. If you remove them
              # only the Site*Season remains
# rerunning the models above with low_cond does not change their results.

# Model evaluation with DHARMa
# Running basic simulation for residuals
library(DHARMa)
simulationOutput <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = lmer_Hem, n = 500)
#simulationOutput$scaledResiduals

#Plotting results
plot(simulationOutput) #looks good

data_Hema_lmer <- Lizard_Master %>% filter(!is.na(Hematocrit),
                                      !is.na(Condition))

#####Checking resids against factors
plotResiduals(simulationOutput, form = data_Hema_lmer$Season) #looks good
plotResiduals(simulationOutput, form = data_Hema_lmer$Site) #looks good
plotResiduals(simulationOutput, form = data_Hema_lmer$Condition)#looks good
plotResiduals(simulationOutput, form = data_Hema_lmer$SexGravid) #looks good 

#####Testing for overdispersion.
testDispersion(simulationOutput) #looks good

# look at interaction
ggplot(data = low_cond, aes(x = Site, y = Hematocrit, color = Season))+
  geom_boxplot()

```
